Body.Content:
The Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server enables copilots to respond to prompts related to data across the Dynamics 365 ERP suite of applications. Users expect visibility into how copilot responses relate to the underlying business data and system records. With this release, copilot responses generated from the Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server will include deep links to the data used to generate the response, improving transparency, traceability, and trust in the AI-generated responses.

Business Value:

Users receive transparency, traceability, and trust in copilot chat experiences with citations and deep links to ERP records in the copilot responses.

Enabled for:

Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/fin-ops-core/dev-itpro/copilot/mcp/mcp-deep-links

GA date: August CY2026

Preview date: May CY2026
